text: The library after the festival. The four-fires question won't leave Kai alone — and neither will Liora, who followed him in carrying her tome.

speaker: Liora
text: You keep circling that shelf like it owes you money. Here. Hold my tome. HOLD it, don't cradle it.
The mark on Kai's brow flares. The tome's first page lights like kindling — and the flame BOWS.

speaker: Liora
text: ...Kai. Students train YEARS for first-flame. It just curtsied at you.

speaker: Kai
text: Four fires at the festival. Four founding lines. Liora — what if the fourth line didn't end?
The school of Ember answers Kai's hand now. (Ember tomes are yours to wield.)
